title: Outreach target specification (v1)
description: Input of compile_search. Documentation of the contract; the skill enforces the same rules with explicit standard-library checks. Lists are de-duplicated case-insensitively (first occurrence kept); order is otherwise preserved.

items.description: A search term: 1 to 100 characters and at most 10 tokens before sanitisation.

titles.description: Job titles; joined with the profile's OR operator and grouped when there are two or more.

items.description: A search term: 1 to 100 characters and at most 10 tokens before sanitisation.

keywords_include.description: Terms each added with the profile's AND operator.

items.description: A search term: 1 to 100 characters and at most 10 tokens before sanitisation.

keywords_exclude.description: Terms each added with the profile's NOT operator; also the exclusion rubric component at ingest.

items.description: A search term: 1 to 100 characters and at most 10 tokens before sanitisation.

industries.description: Industry terms; a query filter when the profile has an industry filter, otherwise a scoring criterion read from the row's company.

seniority.description: Closed set. A query filter when the profile has a seniority filter, otherwise a scoring criterion matched through kb/seniority_terms.json.

geos.description: Two-letter upper-case codes (^[A-Z]{2}$), or values from the profile's geo filter list when the profile gives one.

company_size.description: Values from the profile's company_size filter list; the profile must have that filter.

network.description: Values from the profile's network filter list (connection degree); the profile must have that filter. Carries no rubric weight.

estimated_matches.description: Optional estimate of matching profiles, as read off the platform's own result counter; drives multi-dimension partitioning.
